note: Campground in Veterans Memorial Park, owned jointly by American Legion Post 123 and VFW Post 2019, on W Lebanon St in Mount Airy (Surry Co) beside the Ararat River, within walking distance of downtown and on the paved river trail. Home of the Old-Time Fiddlers Convention: the campground opens the week before for jamming. No drugs or alcohol. Google 4.6 over 610 reviews (the whole park). --Claude
summary: Operator page live with the same rates ($40 full hookup, $30 water/electric, $20 non-hookup; fees left as recorded) and 2-week maximum. Ownership: Veterans Memorial Park, Inc., a nonprofit jointly owned by American Legion Post 123 and VFW Post 2019 (club-run, not the city), so 'private' stands. Added showers, free WiFi, email/phone reservations, site description. Transient: rented by the day, 14-night cap, so the long-stay tests pass. No gateway within 40 km (Charlotte 145 km); base $20 is under the gate anyway. Not stated: amperage, season, site lengths.
